description_en: Queries the results of asynchronous API operations in a specified cluster
description_zh: 调用ListTasks查询指定集群下异步API的返回结果
name: ListTasks

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster that you want to query.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html to obtain the cluster ID

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display historical results of completed asynchronous API operations. Valid values:

true: Displays results of both running and completed tasks.

false: Displays results of only running tasks. If no tasks are running, the task field returns `[]`.

Default value: false.

This parameter does not take effect if you specify the TaskId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
是否显示已运行的异步API的历史返回结果。取值范围：

true：显示正在运行和历史运行的任务返回结果。

false：仅显示正在运行的任务返回结果，当没有正在运行的任务时，task返回为`[]`。

默认值：false。

当您配置了TaskId参数时，此参数无效
parameters.name: archived

Request.description_en: The request parameter information of the task in JSON string format
Request.description_zh: 任务的请求参数信息，格式为JSON字符串

Result.description_en:
The task execution result. Valid values:

If TaskType is CreateCluster or AddComputes, the format is `{"Instances":[]}`, which indicates the information about nodes added to the cluster.

If TaskType is any value other than CreateCluster or AddComputes, the format is `{}`
Result.description_zh:
任务运行结果。可能值：

当TaskType为CreateCluster和AddComputes时，格式为`{\"Instances\":[]}`，表示加入到集群的节点信息。

当TaskType为除CreateCluster和AddComputes的其他值时，格式为`{}`

Status.description_en:
The task execution status. Valid values:

Processing: running
Success: succeeded
Fail: failed
PartialFail: partially failed
Status.description_zh:
任务运行状态。可能值：

Processing：运行中
Success：运行成功
Fail：运行失败
PartialFail：部分运行失败

TaskType.description_en:
The task type. Valid values:

CreateCluster: creates a cluster. The corresponding API operation is [CreateCluster]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87100.html）.
StartCluster: starts a cluster. The corresponding API operation is [StartCluster]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200345.html）.
StopCluster: stops a cluster. The corresponding API operation is [StopCluster]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200346.html）.
DeleteCluster: releases a cluster. The corresponding API operation is [DeleteCluster]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87110.html）.
AddComputes: adds nodes to a cluster. The corresponding API operation is [AddNodes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87147.html）.
StartComputes: starts nodes. The corresponding API operation is [StartNodes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87159.html）.
ResetComputes: resets nodes. The corresponding API operation is [ResetNodes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87158.html）.
StopComputes: stops nodes. The corresponding API operation is [StopNodes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87160.html）.
DeleteComputes: deletes nodes. The corresponding API operation is [DeleteNodes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87155.html）
TaskType.description_zh:
任务类型。可能值：

CreateCluster：创建集群，对应的API为[CreateCluster]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87100.html）
StartCluster：启动集群，对应的API为[StartCluster]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200345.html）
StopCluster：停止集群，对应的API为[StopCluster]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200346.html）
DeleteCluster：释放集群，对应的API为[DeleteCluster]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87110.html）
AddComputes：添加节点到集群，对应的API为[AddNodes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87147.html）
StartComputes：启动节点，对应的API为[StartNodes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87159.html）
ResetComputes：重置节点，对应的API为[ResetNodes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87158.html）
StopComputes：停止节点，对应的API为[StopNodes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87160.html）
DeleteComputes：删除节点，对应的API为[DeleteNodes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87155.html）

TotalSteps.description_en: The total number of steps in the task

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the task list
